visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up shot of a red iPhone mounted on a stand. The screen displays an active call interface with a contact named 'Rong 絨絨'. Large, bold Traditional Chinese captions in yellow and white appear as overlays at the bottom, highlighting a new iPhone feature. (2) A young woman with long, straight dark hair, wearing a gray tank top and a white wristwatch, appears on camera. She holds an orange-cased iPhone in one hand and a circular object in the other, gesturing towards the camera with a cheerful facial expression. The background is an indoor living space with white curtains and a wooden bookshelf. (3) The shot transitions to a full-screen mobile interface recording. It demonstrates a real-time call translation feature where text bubbles in Chinese and Japanese appear chronologically within the calling UI. The woman's voice-over explains the process as the screen displays dialogue interactions. (4) The woman returns to the frame, standing in the same indoor setting. She continues her explanation, pointing to the phone screen which she holds up for the viewer. Her expressions are animated and informative. (5) Another screen recording segment shows a step-by-step walkthrough of the iOS settings menu. A green cursor highlights the 'Live Translation' (即時翻譯) option under the 'More' menu during a call. (6) A language selection list appears on the screen, showing various supported languages like Traditional Chinese, Japanese, French, and English. The interface is clean with standard iOS typography. (7) In the final phase, the woman concludes her presentation. She stands before the camera, smiling and gesturing for viewers to leave comments. The scene remains well-lit with natural-looking indoor light.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 有了 iPhone 這個功能!?. (2) [Slogan]: 以後是不是可以不用學外語了!?. [Variety]: 實測!. (3) [Subtitle]: 畫面經過後製 實際翻譯耗時較長. (4) [Variety]: 此通話已開啟翻譯. (5) [Slogan]: 不過翻譯時會需要一點反應時間 沒辦法不間斷的講話 那操作方法很簡單 帶你做一遍. (6) [Subtitle]: 先撥通電話 等對方成功接聽之後 選擇左下角的三個點點 更多 會看到有個即時翻譯 選好自己和對方的兩種語言 再按下開始. (7) [Subtitle]: 建議可以提前打開螢幕錄影 紀錄畫面上的對話框 讓之後還能回顧重要資訊. (8) [Slogan]: 實測翻譯的結果是 太過口語或是太艱澀的詞比較容易誤翻 那日常的對話會更準確一些. (9) [Slogan]: 提醒大家 目前有支援的語言 就是畫面上的這些喔! 其他的可能要再等等後續版本 更新到 iOS 26.1 就可以用喔!. (10) [Slogan]: 快去試試 留言告訴大家 你想要在什麼時候用?

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy female Mandarin voice speaking enthusiastically. A bright, upbeat electronic pop background track starts immediately, characterized by a steady 4/4 synthetic beat. There are no background noises. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' transition sound effect occurs as the narrator introduces the phone call test. (3) During the call demo, a male voice is heard speaking Japanese in a calm, flat tone, followed by a female voice responding in Mandarin. The BGM ducks in volume to allow the dialogue to be prominent. (4) A digital UI 'click' or 'ding' sound effect is heard when the cursor moves to the translation settings on the screen. (5) The narrator returns with a friendly, professional tone, explaining the limitations of the translation speed. The BGM remains consistent and energetic. (6) The video ends with the narrator's voice reaching a higher pitch during a Call-to-Action, with the BGM fading out as she finishes speaking.
